fact: The Namibia Statistics Agency's International Merchandise Trade Statistics Bulletin for December 2025 reports exports of N$10.7 billion and imports of N$11.1 billion and notes monthly revision as the data sources supply information; the text names no administrative source (customs declarations are not named), and it is an earlier edition of the series continued by April 2026.
title: Namibia International Merchandise Trade Statistics Bulletin December 2025
